listing.original_game_title: Resident Evil Code: Veronica X HD
listing.summary: The project describes native play, 60 FPS and a speedrun route. A complete playthrough is unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PSN version 01.00 game: Europe NPEB00553, USA NPUB30467 or the supported Japan executable. Supply your own PKG and license or complete extracted data. This guide does not establish the exact Japanese serial.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the v1.0 player ZIP instructions to build game code locally from your own files. A separate extractor for your own PKG is optional.

warnings: The project describes native play, 60 FPS and a speedrun route. A complete playthrough is unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
